name: ScopePilot WF01 - Authenticated Intake and Investigation

parameters.query: SELECT case_id, project_id, case_state, deduplicated FROM scopeledger.ingest_email_case($1::text,$2::text,$3::text,$4::text,$5::text,$6::text);

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({status:$json.case_id ? 'duplicate_ignored' : 'routing_blocked',case_id:$json.case_id || null,message:$json.case_id ? 'Provider message already exists; no duplicate investigation started.' : 'Sender did not map to exactly one configured project.'}) }}

parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS case_id,c.project_id,c.request_excerpt,c.evidence_version,p.name AS project_name,p.repo_owner,p.repo_name,p.drive_folder_id,p.currency,sv.id AS scope_version_id,sv.version AS scope_version,sv.normalized_scope,sv.document_id,sv.provider_revision,sv.content_hash FROM scopeledger.cases c JOIN scopeledger.projects p ON p.id=c.project_id JOIN scopeledger.scope_versions sv ON sv.id=p.active_scope_id WHERE c.id=$1::uuid;

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('Fetch Active Scope Metadata').first().json.repo_owner }}/{{ $('Fetch Active Scope Metadata').first().json.repo_name }}/issues?state=open&per_page=100
